module: Flowgraph node 'ARunForLife' (repeat_instant category): complete logic of a small survival mini-game ("Plays my little scenario"). The camera advances at increasing speed along the -Y axis; props (metal_ramp ramp, gate, ball, cannon, caravan, woodcrate/woodplanks/haybale) are activated/deactivated from a vehicle pool (pin 'pool') on 5 lanes, containers are teleported to loop the scenery, and bonuses (coins, repair) appear. The score increases with distance and actions (ramp jump, gate, ball push); the player loses if they stay too long (5 s) outside the camera zone. Many setting input pins, outputs: score, camera speed, trigger positions, medal, signals lost/repaired/coinEarnt/repairSpawned. All state is in module-local variables (not per instance).
notes: Module-global state (score, coins, props, camPos...): two instances of the node would share the state.
The output pins 'repairBuffCost' and 'gatePoints'/'jumpPoints' have the same name as inputs (distinct input and output).
checkBuffAvailabilty depends on coins < repairBuffCost for the coin.
The name 'pipckupSpeed' (typo) is used in moveCamera for the camera catch-up speed.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

linkProps.desc: Gets the pool vehicles (propPool:getVehs()), stores in propsInfo the decals/rotations corrected by jbeam, remembers the ball/cannon/caravan references and the player vehicle (pin plId).

linkContainers.desc: Gathers the ids of existing pins cont1id..cont20id into containers and computes contTpDist (teleport distance = number of containers / 2 * 13.25).

moveCamera.desc: Advances the camera (core_camera.setPosRot): initial then slow acceleration, slowdown/catch-up when slowdownCar is active; writes camSpeed.

tpContainers.desc: Teleports forward the containers that have fallen behind the camera (alternating right/left lane).

doScore.desc: Increases the score according to the player's position relative to the camera, the camera speed and dtSim; writes score.

checkLose.desc: If the player is outside the camera zone, counts up to 5 s (timeLeftToLose) then emits 'lost'; otherwise resets the count to -1.

pushBall.desc: If the ball is active and has moved more than 3 m, adds points proportional to the distance traveled (ballPoint per meter) to the score and bonus points; writes ballPoints.

checkBuffAvailabilty.desc: Updates repairAvailable and coinAvailable (the coin is only available while coins < repairBuffCost).

doBuffsTime.desc: Advances the timers of the bonuses that use time (coin) until they become available.

checkCoinForRepair.desc: When enough coins are collected, spends them, makes the repair bonus available and emits repairSpawned.

deactivateBuff.desc: Deactivates a bonus (off-screen, position {-1,0,0}) and updates the position of the corresponding trigger.

getBuffNextTime.desc: Returns a random delay around baseTime (+/- 25%).

activateBuff.desc: Activates a bonus at a position, updates the trigger position on the corresponding output.

deactivateProp.desc: Shows the help decal of a deactivated prop again.

deactivatePropsAndBuffs.desc: Deactivates the props and bonuses that are too far behind the camera (propDespawn = 40 m) and puts them back in the inactive props list.

getBuffByName.desc: Returns the bonus with this name ('repair' or 'coin').

getPropByName.desc: Returns the prop info (propsInfo) for a jbeam name.

activatePropsAndBuffs.desc: Periodically spawns lines of props (random number between minPropLine and maxPropLine, no duplicate lane) and places the available bonuses.

moveTriggers.desc: Updates the outputs gatePos, rampPos, cannonPos from the position of the active props.

updateValues.desc: Every frame: resets outputs to their default values, reads the position/rotation of the camera and the player, updates jumpPoints, gatePoints, totalBonusScore, coins.

setReferences.desc: Gets the pool, links containers and props, fills the active/inactive prop lists.

drawDecals.desc: Draws the decals (arrows) on the props that have decal.draw active.

slowDownCar.desc: During repair, waits until the vehicle is almost stopped (< 0.1 m/s) then unfreezes it, emits 'repaired'.

repairBuff.desc: Freezes the player vehicle (setFreeze), deactivates the repair bonus and starts the slowdown.

coinBuff.desc: Adds a coin, deactivates the coin bonus and emits coinEarnt (if the repair is not yet purchasable).

checkTriggers.desc: Handles the input impulses: cannon (fire via custom_input.fire), jumpRamp, crashGate (points), repairTrigger, coinTrigger.

calcMedal.desc: Determines the medal (Gold, Silver, Bronze, Wood) and the next score according to the gold/silver/bronze pins.

resetValues.desc: Resets the whole game state to zero and recreates the bonus table (repair, coin).

setParameters.desc: Copies the non-nil setting pins to the module-local variables.

work.desc: Game loop: optional reset, one-time initialization (parameters, references, decal pool), then chains updateValues, tpContainers, moveCamera, doScore, checkLose, checkTriggers, props/bonus handling, pushBall, moveTriggers, drawDecals, calcMedal, checkCoinForRepair, slowDownCar; writes drawCannon.
